unionIntersectionsProof: For k<m, {N>=k+1} is the union, over subsets S of size k+1, of intersection_{i in S} F_i.
P(intersection_{i in S} F_i)<=min_{i in S}p_i, so the union bound gives P(N>=k+1)<=sum_{|S|=k+1}min_{i in S}p_i.

The success lower bound is max(0,1-that sum). For k=m there are no such subsets and success is certain. This valid bound can be weaker than the existing subset-Markov bound; no combinatorial API is required.
